_readme.what: Append-only ledger of every buy, sell and corporate action. This is the source of truth: holdings, cost basis, realised P&L, TWR and IRR are all DERIVED from it by pipeline/ledger.py. Never hand-edit holdings.json positions again — edit this instead.

event_types.buy: { type, ticker, date, shares, price, fee?, note? }  price = price per share AS TRADED that day
event_types.sell: { type, ticker, date, shares, price, fee?, note? }  same convention
event_types.split: { type, ticker, date, ratio, note? }                ratio = share-count multiplier. 2 = 2-for-1. 0.1 = 1-for-10 reverse.
event_types.dividend: { type, ticker, date, amount, note? }               CASH dividends only. If it was reinvested (DRIP), record a buy instead.

rules: Prices are always as-traded. Do NOT back-adjust for splits — the replay engine does that.
Order within the same date is file order, so if a split applied before a same-day fill, list the split first.
Fees capitalise into cost basis on buys and reduce proceeds on sells.
Fractional shares are fine; 6 decimal places are preserved.
